scope.source: in-memory immutable source with simulated caller-side ReadAt cap/delay; no physical disk or network latency
scope.source_metrics_claim: logical ReadAt observer only when source-metrics is enabled; cap/delay model simulated caller latency
scope.timing: first public operation after session/package metadata setup
scope.cpu_time: ProcessCPUTime interval is process-wide and may be slightly wider than wall timing

metrics.source_metrics_scope: CFB and source-backed Parts timed operation only; counters reset after preload; source cap/delay are simulated in-memory caller latency
